description: The Python SQL Toolkit and Object Relational Mapper

slides.title: Core vs ORM
slides.content:
# Two Layers 🍰

1. **Core**: SQL Expression Language. Pythonic way to write SQL.
   `select([users]).where(users.c.name == 'ed')`
2. **ORM**: High-level Object abstraction (Like Django ORM).

## Establishing Connection
The **Engine** is the starting point.
```alchemy
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
engine = create_engine('sqlite:///example.db')
```

slides.title: Declarative Mapping
slides.content:
# Defining Models 🏗️

```alchemy
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, Session
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)

# Create tables
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
```

slides.title: Session & Queries
slides.content:
# Interacting with DB 🤝

Use a **Session** to manage transactions.

```alchemy
session = Session(engine)

# Create
ed = User(name='Ed')
session.add(ed)
session.commit()

# Query
our_user = session.query(User).filter_by(name='Ed').first()
```
